sections.Profile:
"Gaucho" is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1963. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, five pop bumpers, four passive bumpers, two slingshots, two roto-targets, and a standup target.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Foreign Peoples, Original Theme, Adventure
